title: Two trains collide in Egypt, killing seven
en: Seven people were killed and more than 100 injured when two trains collided south of Cairo on Sunday, officials said. The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 30 miles south of the capital, when a train travelling to Fayoum crashed into the rear of a train heading to Aswan that had been stationary on the same track. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ordered a prompt investigation, and the health ministry said 45 of the injured had been discharged from hospital. Train accidents are common in Egypt, where the railway system has long suffered from mismanagement and poor maintenance. The country's deadliest crash, in 2002, killed more than 300 people.
zh: 埃及官员称，周日两列火车在开罗以南相撞，造成7人死亡、100多人受伤。事故发生在吉萨省阿亚特地区，位于首都以南约30英里处，一列开往法尤姆的列车撞上了停在同一条轨道上、开往阿斯旺方向列车的尾部。总统塞西下令迅速调查，卫生部称45名伤者已出院。埃及铁路系统长期存在管理不善和维护不足的问题，列车事故频发。2002年该国最严重的列车事故造成300多人死亡。

title: Nasdaq to launch 23-hour trading on December 6
src: Nasdaq / 证券时报 · 财经
en: Nasdaq is about to enter the age of near-round-the-clock trading. The exchange will implement its 23/5 schedule on December 6, opening for 23 hours a day, five days a week, from 9 pm on Sunday to 8 pm on Friday. The only daily pause is a one-hour maintenance window from 8 to 9 pm Eastern time, reserved for system upkeep, stress testing and corporate actions such as dividend payments and stock splits. The plan, already approved by the US Securities and Exchange Commission, is the biggest change to Nasdaq's trading system since its founding in 1971. The new overnight session covers daytime hours in Asia, so investors there no longer have to wait for New York to open.
zh: 纳斯达克即将进入近全天候交易时代。该交易所将于12月6日实施23/5交易制度，每周5天、每天23小时运行，从周日21时持续至周五20时。每日仅保留美东时间20时至21时一小时维护窗口，用于系统维护、压力测试以及股息支付、股票拆分等公司行为处理。该方案已获美国证监会批准，是纳斯达克1971年成立以来交易制度层面的最大变革。新增隔夜时段恰好覆盖亚洲白天时间，亚洲投资者无需再等到纽约开盘。
vocab: n. 公司行为（股息、拆股等）

title: Trump: fresh strikes on Iran 'highly unlikely' if talks progress
en: US President Donald Trump said on Sunday he was highly unlikely to order fresh attacks on Iran as long as talks to end the conflict make progress. It depends on whether or not they sign a very strong agreement, Trump told CNN in a phone interview, adding that if strikes resumed, the US had identified infrastructure targets, including 38 bridges that we can knock down in literally one hour. He said three aircraft carriers were deployed in the region and fully ready. His remarks came as Iran's Revolutionary Guards said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while passing through an unauthorised route in the Strait of Hormuz. Qatar, which is mediating between Washington and Tehran, said efforts to reach a deal were continuing.
zh: 美国总统特朗普周日表示，只要结束冲突的谈判取得进展，他再次下令打击伊朗的可能性就极低。特朗普在CNN电话采访中说，这取决于他们是否签署一项非常有力的协议，并称若恢复打击，美方已确定包括38座桥梁在内、一小时内就能摧毁的基础设施目标。他表示，三艘航空母舰已部署在该地区并完全就绪。同日，伊朗革命卫队称三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡未经授权航线触雷起火。正在美伊之间斡旋的卡塔尔表示，达成协议的努力仍在继续。

title: Chinese AI models take 89% of global open-source spending
en: Chinese AI models now dominate the global open-source market. According to Menlo Ventures' 2026 Corporate AI Status report, Chinese models captured 89 percent of corporate spending on open-source AI: Moonshot AI's Kimi led with 61 percent, followed by DeepSeek with 15 percent and Z.ai's GLM with 11 percent, while Meta's Llama, the leading Western model, took just 7 percent. Businesses favour Chinese models for repetitive, cost-sensitive tasks, and even US companies have begun building on them. But monetisation remains hard: token processing volume for open-source models surged 22.5 times in a year, yet their share of total corporate AI spending fell from 6 percent to 4 percent, while Anthropic and OpenAI together claimed 86 percent of the paid market.
zh: 中国AI模型如今主导全球开源市场。Menlo Ventures《2026企业AI现状》报告显示，中国企业模型占全球企业开源AI模型支出的89%：月之暗面Kimi以61%居首，DeepSeek占15%，智谱GLM占11%；份额最高的西方模型Meta Llama仅占7%。企业倾向用中国模型处理重复性、成本敏感的任务，甚至美国公司也开始基于其构建产品。但变现依然困难：开源模型token处理量一年激增22.5倍，占企业AI总支出的份额却从6%降至4%，而付费市场86%由Anthropic与OpenAI瓜分。

title: SpaceX targets November 13 for Starship's first full recovery
src: SpaceX / 界面新闻 · 科技
en: SpaceX said its Starship rocket system will make its 15th test flight as early as November 13, pending regulatory approval. The 75-minute launch window will open at 4:45 pm Central Time. The mission will mark the first attempt to catch both the Starship spacecraft and its Super Heavy V3 booster back at the launch site using the tower's mechanical arms. If successful, this will mark the first full recovery of an orbital launch system and a breakthrough moment in making Starship a reliable, rapidly reusable rocket, the company said. The flight will also deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites and complete about 14 orbits of Earth during a mission lasting more than 22 hours.
zh: SpaceX宣布，星舰火箭系统最早将于11月13日进行第15次试飞，尚待监管部门批准。75分钟发射窗口将于中部时间16时45分开启。此次任务将首次尝试让星舰飞船与超重型V3助推器一同返回发射场，由发射塔机械臂捕获。SpaceX表示，若成功，这将是轨道级发射系统的首次整体回收，也是星舰成为可靠、可快速复用火箭的突破性时刻。飞船还将部署26颗星链V3卫星，并在超过22小时的任务中绕地球飞行约14圈。

title: NASA unveils nuclear-powered lunar rover Endurance
en: NASA has selected eight companies for a new 10-year round of its lunar delivery services programme as it pushes ahead with plans for a crewed moon base. Announcing the framework at an aerospace expo in Florida, the agency said its nuclear-powered rover Endurance is planned to launch by the end of 2028 on an 18-month mission to the lunar south pole. The six-wheeled rover will drill about one metre below the surface to study water ice and other resources, providing data for choosing future landing sites and building infrastructure. NASA said a nuclear-powered rover can operate through the two-week lunar night and in permanently shadowed regions, which is critical for long-term human presence. Blue Origin will deliver the rover using its Mark 1 vehicle.
zh: 美国航天局选定8家公司参与为期10年的新一轮月球商业运载服务计划，推进载人月球基地建设。该局在佛罗里达州一场航空航天展会上发布合同框架，并表示核动力月球车承诺号计划于2028年底发射，执行为期18个月的任务，在月球南极着陆。这辆六轮月球车将向月表以下约1米处钻探，研究水冰等资源，为未来着陆点选择和基础设施建设提供数据。NASA称，核动力月球车可在长达两周的月夜和永久阴影区运行，对人类长期驻留月球至关重要。蓝色起源公司将用其马克一号飞船运送该车。
